records.title: Targeted data augmentation to improve the simulation of extreme floods with regional deep learning models
records.author: Dolich, Alexander and Reis, Paul and Vorogushyn, Sergiy and Nguyen, Viet Dung and Dasgupta, Antara and Loritz, Ralf
records.use: Extreme-flow evaluation and July 2021 interpretation; standard historical scores can conceal failures at extremes.
records.limit: LSTM output saturation is not evidence of saturation in our EO encoders. No augmentation or new model run is proposed.

records.title: Linking rainfall spatial organization and distributed travel times to critical flood-contributing areas in a mountainous urban catchment
records.author: Zapata, Esneider and Carmona, Alejandra M. and Barco, Janet
records.use: Interpret event differences through rainfall placement, movement and drainage connectivity alongside rainfall totals.
records.limit: Four events in Colombia provide preliminary evidence, not validation of a Limburg encoder or a new requirement for distributed travel-time modelling.
